ddl.m_table_sequence: CREATE TABLE m_table_sequence (seq_table_id SMALLINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL, next_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL , PRIMARY KEY (seq_table_id) )
ddl.m_tag: CREATE TABLE m_tag (tag_id INT NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, hash BINARY(32) NOT NULL, ast_id INT NOT NULL, hl_s INT NOT NULL, hl_l INT NOT NULL , PRIMARY KEY (tag_id) , INDEX tag_hash_idx (hash) , INDEX tag_ast_idx (ast_id) ,FOREIGN KEY (ast_id) REFERENCES m_ast(ast_id))
ddl.m_tag_def: CREATE TABLE m_tag_def (tag_id INT NOT NULL, def_idx SMALLINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL, sym_key BIGINT NOT NULL, name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL COLLATE utf8mb4_bin, type_id TINYINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL, linkage TINYINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, rel_line_s MEDIUMINT NOT NULL, rel_line_e MEDIUMINT NOT NULL , PRIMARY KEY (tag_id, def_idx) , INDEX tag_def_name_idx (name, type_id) , INDEX tag_def_key_idx (sym_key, tag_id) ,FOREIGN KEY (tag_id) REFERENCES m_tag(tag_id))
ddl.m_tag_ref: CREATE TABLE m_tag_ref (tag_id INT NOT NULL, ref_idx MEDIUMINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL, sym_key BIGINT NOT NULL, role TINYINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL, rel_line MEDIUMINT NOT NULL, char_s MEDIUMINT NOT NULL , PRIMARY KEY (tag_id, ref_idx) , INDEX tag_ref_key_idx (sym_key, tag_id) ,FOREIGN KEY (tag_id) REFERENCES m_tag(tag_id))
ddl.m_type_descriptor: CREATE TABLE m_type_descriptor (type_id SMALLINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL, name VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL COLLATE utf8mb4_bin , PRIMARY KEY (type_id) )
